dedupe_keys.name: dry season irrigated cropland of nigeria at about 5 m 2022 and 2024

description: This dataset gives binary pixel maps of dry season cropland in northern Nigeria for the 2022 season (December 2021 to May 2022) and the 2024 season (December 2023 to May 2024), at Planet resolution of about 5 m. The Zenodo record says values are 1 for dry season cropland and 0 otherwise, the extent is 4 to 14 degrees east and 8 to 14 degrees north in WGS84, and the files also include an Excel table of irrigated cropland area, training points and a readme. It was published in December 2025 by Bhoktear Mahbub Khan and Kyle Frankel Davis, the latter of the University of Delaware, under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as five files of about 100 MB. Coverage is northern Nigeria. Caveats: dry season cropland is used as a proxy for irrigation, and only two seasons are mapped. For simulation it gives where dry season irrigated farming depends on water supply to model drought and reservoir or groundwater shortfall impacts. Related catalogue records include MIRCA2000 and the FAO cropland agreement map.
name: Dry season irrigated cropland of Nigeria at about 5 m (2022 and 2024)
